method: Root inspection and delegated transport_performance and sonar_api_fit source checks.

findings.fact: Each connector call starts a subprocess and creates then closes its MCP client and server.
findings.consequence: Per-query bridge calls repeat process and initialization work.
findings.action: Use one transient session per connector for a collection.

findings.fact: Workbench.call holds its lock throughout provider execution.
findings.consequence: Parallel outer calls through one Workbench instance serialize.
findings.action: Schedule bounded query concurrency inside one collection action.

findings.fact: Native ADO creates a fresh WebApi per tool; Sonar tools create Axios clients per call.
findings.consequence: A persistent bridge alone does not establish reusable API clients.
findings.action: Cache job-scoped connections and service clients with explicit connection pooling.

findings.fact: Current work item reads omit expanded relations; the batch tool sends all IDs without chunking.
findings.consequence: Existing generic tools are insufficient for complete release traversal unchanged.
findings.action: Add structured expanded reads and bounded batching through the connector layer.

findings.fact: Build reads accept buildIds but omit continuation control; test outputs drop case identities.
findings.consequence: Complete collection needs focused reader extensions.
findings.action: Preserve pagination, result identities, raw payloads, and completeness metadata.

findings.fact: Native Sonar uses root configuration and covers six read categories, with incomplete paging and selector support.
findings.consequence: The existing connector is reusable but needs structured complete reads.
findings.action: Reuse the native connection and add selectors, pagination, and structured outputs.

findings.fact: Copied Sonar uses an embedded host and numeric conversion; the active release service reads ADO coverage.
findings.consequence: Copying the wrapper can misidentify the endpoint, metric types, or evidence source.
findings.action: Port useful metric mappings only; keep ADO and Sonar evidence separate.

findings.fact: Neither inspected report path proves a build commit matches a Sonar analysis.
findings.consequence: Current branch metrics cannot establish historical build quality.
findings.action: Resolve analysis identity from build metadata and label unmatched snapshots explicitly.

findings.fact: Connector responses are limited to four MiB and the current workspace timeout is thirty seconds.
findings.consequence: A large aggregate response or existing timeout can interrupt complete collection.
findings.action: Persist bounded pages, return a small manifest, and implement an explicit collection deadline.

limits: No performance benchmark, live endpoint request, or runtime change occurred.
limitations: Automated checks do not check the complete approved dictionary or grammar rules.
